title: A 300-380 keV line from the sky: what INTEGRAL/SPI, COMPTEL and future MeV telescopes say about a long-lived excited dark-matter state
question: If a fraction f2 of the DM is in the excited state chi2 today and decays radiatively with lifetime tau_gamma >> t_U, what Galactic 300-380 keV line flux and extragalactic continuum result, what do recalled SPI/COSI sensitivities and the CXB imply for f2/tau_gamma, and where do the corpus models (Higgsino, dark photon, MiDM, generic long-lived chi2) sit?
headline_result: Phi(10 deg cone) = 6.0e-5 (f2/tau_gamma / 1e-22 s^-1)(TeV/m) ph cm^-2 s^-1 for NFW (D10 = 7.48e21 GeV cm^-2 sr, reproducing P026), so recalled SPI narrow-line sensitivities 3e-6-3e-5 give f2/tau_gamma < 5e-24-5e-23 s^-1 (CXB continuum: 3.3e-20-3.3e-21, profile-independent); with LZ's exothermic f2 <= 1.2e-3 the brightest LZ-compatible line is 1e-2 BR_gamma, so BR_gamma < 3e-4-3e-3 at delta = 300 keV; a generic f2 = 0.42 photon-only chi2 is excluded for tau_gamma < 0.8-8e22 s; Higgsino (tau_gamma 0.06 s), MiDM (66 us) and pure kinetic-mixing dark photon (BR_gamma = 0) predict no line
key_numbers: D NFW/Einasto/Burkert: 10 deg 7.48/9.34/3.61e21, 30 deg box 4.55/5.08/3.27e22, all-sky 2.03/2.06/1.78e23 GeV cm^-2 sr; Phi at f2/tau=1e-22: 6.0e-5 (10 deg), 3.6e-4 (30 deg box), 1.6e-3 (all sky); f2/tau bounds SPI 10 deg 5e-24-5e-23, 47.5 deg box 1.6e-24-1.6e-23, CXB 3.3e-20 (100%)/3.3e-21 (10%); generic f2=0.42: Phi10 = 2.5e-3 at 1e20 s, excluded tau < 0.8-8e22 s; dark photon + dipole at exothermic boundary Phi10 = 1.0e-2 BR_gamma -> BR_gamma < 3e-4-3e-3 (300 keV), 4e-3-4e-2 (350), none (380); line FWHM 0.40 keV, dipole +-0.25 keV, recoil 0.045 eV; GC/anticentre contrast 18.6/25.2/5.5
model_or_mechanism: radiative decay chi2 -> chi1 gamma of a relic excited population in the Galactic halo (Phi = f2 D/(4 pi m tau)); NFW/Einasto/Burkert D-factors on HEALPix; redshifted decay continuum dI/dE = c Gamma n0/(4 pi E H(z)) vs Gruber-1999 CXB; corpus lifetimes and exothermic bound
confidence: medium - D-factors and fluxes computed and validated to 0.7%, but every gamma-ray sensitivity and the CXB level are recalled factor-2-3 brackets
